title: Medical Excellence Award – PDA Silver Jubilee, Rajatha Pournami 2026
summary: Honoured with the Medical Excellence Award during Rajatha Pournami 2026, the Silver Jubilee celebrations of the Pathanamthitta District Association, Kuwait, recognising distinguished contributions to the medical profession and community service.
description:
The Pathanamthitta District Association (PDA), Kuwait, celebrated its Silver Jubilee through Rajatha Pournami 2026 on 13 February 2026 at the Central School Auditorium, Abbassiya, commemorating 25 years of community engagement, cultural heritage and collective achievement.

As part of the celebrations, the association presented its prestigious Excellence Awards, recognising individuals who have made meaningful contributions across various professional and social fields.

The Medical Excellence Award was conferred in recognition of outstanding contributions to healthcare, professional dedication and commitment to the well-being of the community.

The celebrations featured distinguished guests, including H.E. Paramita Tripathi, Ambassador of India to Kuwait; Mrs. Veena George, Kerala's Health Minister; and Mr. Anto Antony, Member of Parliament.

A cherished recognition that reflects the importance of professional excellence, compassionate healthcare and sustained service to society.

title: IBPC Kuwait – Recognition for Outstanding Community Service
summary: A prestigious recognition presented to Dr. Susovana Sujit Nair at the IBPC Kuwait Annual Function and Awards Night 2025, honouring her dedication to community service, cancer awareness and India–Kuwait medical collaboration.
description:
At the prestigious IBPC Kuwait Annual Function and Awards Night 2025, held on 12 November 2025 at Waldorf Astoria, Kuwait, Dr. Susovana Sujit Nair was honoured for her unwavering dedication to community service, cancer awareness and contributions towards strengthening India–Kuwait medical collaboration.

The recognition was presented by Mr. Abdulla Alherz, Director of International Relations at Kuwait's Ministry of Commerce and Industry, on behalf of Minister Khalifa Abdullah Al-Ajil.

The distinguished occasion was graced by Ms. Paramita Tripathi as Chief Guest, with Ms. Roshni Nadar Malhotra as Guest of Honour and keynote speaker.

The honour represented a meaningful acknowledgement of sustained efforts to take cancer awareness, early detection education and healthcare knowledge beyond hospital settings and into the wider community.
